_doc: ADR-0102 D-A/D-B/D-C/D-D: Shared specification file for plain-language generator principles and detector substitution table (grill-mental-model, ledger D-006, D-007). Governed under one change ticket via the ADR mechanism.

generator_principles.title: One word, one meaning
generator_principles.statute: A concept carries exactly one name. Reject compound welding of new jargon for existing concepts.

generator_principles.title: Complete short sentences
generator_principles.statute: Write complete short sentences without long welded noun chains.
generator_principles.origin: Sweden plain-language statutory form / US Plain Writing Act

generator_principles.title: Register before use
generator_principles.statute: A new term must have a CONTEXT.md entry before it may appear in mandatory faces.

substitution_table.substitute: 收词分诊通道 / 延后处理项
substitution_table.reason: The term 豁免阀 (exemption valve) is forbidden by the ADR-0102 D-B wording law (inherited from ADR-0098 D-C; ADR-0100 retired in 62a71522); triage discloses and defers, but never exempts.
Counting unqualified rules as barriers manufactures a false sense of multiple protection (ADR-0101 D-C / Primatech warning).
substitution_table.condition: Rules must pass the IPL triple test (effective, independent, auditable) before counting as barriers.

substitution_table.substitute: Bow-tie 骨架 (独立预防屏障 + 减缓屏障)
substitution_table.reason: Defense-in-depth is an engineering property, not the bow-tie architectural mapping; prevention and mitigation layers remain strictly independent (ADR-0101 D-A).
substitution_table.condition: Used strictly in the context of generic software defense in depth rather than the two-profile architecture mapping.

mandatory_face.reach: Table plus principles enforced. Encompasses git commit messages, ADR bodies, and CONTEXT.md entries.

principle_face.reach: Principles only, no lint (src/SKILL.md). The product face remains plain without lint interruptions.

light_disclosure_face.reach: Principles plus optional future light-disclosure footer for final replies to humans.

three_face_reach.policy: New document types default into the mandatory face; an exception requires an ADR change ticket (ADR-0102 D-D).
